slides.title: "Basically"
slides.body: Start with the point instead. Pause for one second - silence sounds more confident than fillers.

slides.title: "Actually"
slides.body: Used every sentence, it sounds like you're correcting yourself. Save it for real corrections.

slides.title: "Like" and "you know"
slides.body: Replace with a short pause. Pauses feel long to you, but sound calm to the listener.

slides.title: "Sorry, sorry"
slides.body: Don't apologise for small slips. Just repeat the sentence correctly and keep going.

caption:
Your English might be fine - your fillers are what make you sound nervous.

Basically, actually, like, you know, sorry... all of these fill silence. A 1-second pause sounds far more confident.

Which filler do you use the most? Be honest 😅👇
